measurementContract.instrumentation: explicit stage contexts and sampled RSS; no cProfile
measurementContract.elapsed: admitted.build_report only; selected output included, diagnostic report/preview writes excluded
measurementContract.inputGuard: source-file bytes only, not a bound on decompressed bytes, rows, memory or runtime
measurementContract.boundaries: explicit disjoint stage windows; overhead/bookkeeping outside windows remains in total
measurementContract.allocation: isolated target ordering/context allocation loop per level, excludes pair-evidence pruning/output
measurementContract.memory: sampled whole-process RSS within each stage window; observed lower bound, not allocation accounting
measurementContract.reuse: same process and filesystem; database recreated and all input checks repeated
measurementContract.cold: OS page cache is uncontrolled; first run is not a proven cold-cache run
measurementContract.scope: bounded input results cannot predict full corpus cost or classifier accuracy

stageMetrics.timingSemantics: inclusive nested windows; exclusive clocks subtract measured children; process CPU includes sampler and other threads; instrumentation overhead included
stageMetrics.rssSemantics: sampled stage-window maximum is a lower bound; shared/current whole-process RSS, not exact allocations or isolated stage memory; nested windows overlap; GIL/scheduling may delay samples
